baseline.head: f1a46ea89a77ef96f9fa1405acda4ab0a40a779c
baseline.description: Frozen working tree including pre-existing uncommitted Monaco, Codemode and base runtime changes; not the clean HEAD tree.

documentation.settingsDocDifference: Only the description of compaction.reserveTokens differs from installed documentation.

method.isolation: Temporary SQLite, Issue roots, files and in-memory sessions. No production Issue messages, model credentials, paid requests or real evidence sources.
method.provider: Deterministic faux provider drives actual SDK sessions and the actual Codemode worker.
method.validation: 15 scenarios over direct and nested Codemode calls. A trusted test extension mutates arguments in tool_call after SDK validation. Effects count publications, workspace preparation/service removal, and calls to a synthetic MCP binding.
method.benchmark: Actual local service_query execute path, targeting the last declared scope. One MCP tool per scope, structured synthetic response. SDK validation, model, protocol network and database time excluded. 1,000 warmups and five rounds of 10,000 calls, run variants sequentially.
method.session: 3 configurations (empty, partial and custom) × 3 Codemode modes. Compare effective settings and tools before/after reopen; run native Git identity reads before/after a valid update and a rejected update.
limitations: Synthetic contract checks do not measure model reasoning quality, token use, provider retries, remote latency or complete business performance.
Synthetic MCP binding is a counted local seam; real MCP transport, authorization, cancellation and cleanup are covered by the focused and full suites.
No conclusion about every unused path follows from TypeScript noUnused checks.

baseline.change: Original interpreter Value.Parse guards, four explicit Pi defaults, Git identity validation at startup/update and each Bash spawn.

unchecked.change: Remove local execute input guards from service_query/output/workspace; leave SDK validation and business owners intact.

compiled.change: Compile the same schemas once and use Check at execute entry; preserve stable service/output errors and normalize workspace invalid input.

native-defaults.change: Remove explicit compaction/retry enabled and one-at-a-time steering/follow-up defaults; use SDK defaults.

identity-on-update.change: Calculate validated Git identity environment at session creation and identity updates; Bash reads that environment.
